t-devices2.title: Healing devices, round 2: waiting on your picks
t-devices2.body: Pictures of the station, the bed emitter, the pylon as a two-bed station and a dressed tent are under Decisions pending. Then model (about 30 credits each) and place.
t-devices2.waitingFor: your picks in decisions pc6-station and pc6-emitter

t-triage.title: Triage dressing sheet: redraw so it splits
t-triage.body: Meshy fused sheet b into one object (30 credits lost): its props touched. Redrawn with wide gaps; waiting on your OK (Decisions pending), then a website render with retries.

evidence.cap: Sheet b: props too close to split

t-place-devices.title: Model and place the healing devices
t-place-devices.body: After your pick: a station per tent where its glyph line ends, an emitter per cot; about 30 credits a model.

evidence.cap: Where the glyph lines end by the tents

t-beauty.title: Beauty check
t-beauty.body: The whole place at the game camera, with a Codex second opinion, before calling it done.

t-beach-rail.title: The beach keeps a sea-wall balustrade along the water
t-beach-rail.body: A balustrade runs along the sand at the water's edge, where a beach would just meet the sea.

t-birch.title: Birches are plain pale sticks
t-birch.body: No bark marks, no branches showing.

evidence.cap: A birch in the north wood

t-wisteria.title: The wisteria tree reads as a round lilac shrub
t-wisteria.body: It should hang in long drooping clusters.

t-cove-vines.title: Few vines on the middle cove cliff
t-cove-vines.body: The cliff behind the purifier's tower is bare where the sides have vines.

t-fields.title: Fields are bright with hard edges
t-fields.body: The crop rows sit on bare earth strips with straight hard borders.

evidence.cap: The fields west of the forecourt

t-shrubs.title: Shrubs are lumpy up close
t-shrubs.body: The bushes read as clusters of round lobes.

evidence.cap: Shrubs on the bed south of the well

t-road.title: The road out's paving is very broken up
t-road.body: Most of the road is near lawn, so the weathering takes most of its stones.

evidence.cap: The road out to the battery

t-wire.title: Wire the fix into the game (another session)
t-wire.body: The fix can relight the glyph lines (setGlyphState) and draw back the vines (setOvergrowth); nothing calls them yet.

t-planh.title: Plan H picked and built in 3D

t-models.title: The models
t-models.body: Well, tents, greenhouse, stills, boiler house, smokestack, purifier, camp kit: 330 credits in all (two sheets failed).

t-magic.title: Glyph paths, vines that draw back, smoke
